notes.title: TPORT - Prerecorded puzzle walkthroughs
notes.content:
TPORT is a first-person puzzle game with a teleporting mechanics.
Enter puzzle rooms that can only be solved via utilizing personal teleporter units.
Discover the secrets of the tech giant IRT and its teleporting technology.

notes.title: Thumbs up!
notes.content:
Thank you all for the great support!

What makes the game even more visible on steam is if TPORT would hit the 10th positive review.
So please, if you had fun with the game and can spare 2 minutes give a thumbs up.
Thank you very much!

For all the wishlisters make sure to keep a close look on TPORT ... the next sale is coming in a few weeks :)
